submarket: HIDDEN MARKET (How to manage family after the baby arrives)

finding.headline: "The Post-Omugwo Reclaim"
finding.problem: Your mother-in-law (or mum) arrives "to help" with omugwo but quietly takes over — the crib, the first bath, the night feeds, and your voice — while your husband stays silent and culture says "don't complain." You're healing from birth yet managing a household guest and a identity crisis.
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET (How to manage family after the baby arrives)
finding.person: Mum after the gran leaves, needing to assert her own routine without relapse of control/guilt.
